unit:src/features/settings/__tests__/cma.text: 2 of 2 cases through Settings in a project: the stored CMake and build arguments (spaces, quotes, an empty word, a backslash path) are shown as a command line that reads back as the same words, text typed stays as typed and is staged as its words, and Settings reopened shows the words applied; switching profiles after an unfinished quote shows the other profile's arguments

unit:src/features/settings/__tests__/lan.text: 1 of 2 cases: without a project the choice is shown but not editable. unit:src/features/settings/__tests__/php.text: 3 of 4 cases: the selected PHP's version and Xdebug, the row hidden while a new interpreter is checked and then Not installed; the Default interpreter checks the php found on the PATH; the row stays hidden while checking and after a failed check. Missing: Xdebug is not checked again when the installations are detected again (PhpInterpreterView asks only when the selected path changes; LanguagePages.tsx:161-176 re-checks per detection)

unit:src/features/settings/__tests__/jav.text: 1 of 2 cases, by the search keywords only: Formatting profile belongs to the Java code style page, not Rust's. Missing: the Code Style language pages draw no controls natively (the dialog shows 'not available'), so the Formatting profile, Eclipse formatter XML with Browse… and Reset to Language Defaults are absent (codeStyle.tsx:230,245,266-275)

unit:src/features/settings/__tests__/mai.text: 1 of 3 cases on a macOS build: no Main menu choice is drawn without the frameless title bar (the run-time platform switch has no native counterpart; the title bar is frameless by compile-time OS). The {} default is the ide-core test settings::tests::main_menu_style_defaults_and_round_trips. Missing: an invalid stored value ('unknown') is not replaced by hamburger (behaviorSchema.ts:166)
